method: read by eye off tools/board_crop.swift output, grid every 100 frame-px with a heavy line every 500
accuracy: centres are good to roughly +/-20px, so score with --tol 90 or looser; the point of these labels is whether a tower was FOUND, not sub-pixel localisation
caveats: t=330 is the end-of-match moment (the opponent's GOOD GAME! emote is up), so it may be a transition frame rather than clean play

the opponent board region overlaps the centre send-queue by about 21px at its inner edge (queue spans frame x 1225..1340, board starts at 1319), so a blob within ~20px of x=1319 may be queue chrome rather than a tower
identities are my reading of the sprites and are not needed for scoring; only the positions are

checkpoints.note: both tacks upgraded (pink -> red and blue), a blue tower added top-right, a second bomb added
end of match; orange tower added top, bombs now four across the bottom

note: HELD-OUT block only (t>=180). Parameters were chosen on t<180 and never touched these.
